newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Apator sets issue price at PLN 20-25.
newsitem.headline: Polish Apator sets issue price at PLN 20-25.

text.p: Polish electric gauge producer Apator SA set the issue price of its initial public offering at between 20 and 25 zlotys per share, the firm said in an abbreviated version of its issue prospectus.
It said the final issue price would be set through book-building and would be announced at least two days before the subscription begins.
Apator, which seeks the main market's listing, will offer 800,000 new shares and 600,015 existing shares, currently belonging mainly to employees. The registration period is between January 27-31.
It said Creditanstalt Securities underwrote all 800,000 shares of the new issue for a stand-by fee of three percent.
Apator estimated its 1996 net profit at four million zlotys on sales of 75.5 million zloty and expected to lift it to 6.2 million this year on sales of 93.8 million zloty.
In the first nine months of 1996 it showed a net profit of 5.8 million zlotys on sales of 52.8 million zlotys.
